color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x00000 - 0x003FF | 1 KiB
IVT - real-mode interrupt vector table

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x00400 - 0x004FF | 256 B
BDA - BIOS data area

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x00500 - 0x006FF | 512 B
BIOS scratch, and the disk.S real-mode window: thunk copy at 0x500, INT 13h parameter block at 0x600

div.style: color: rgb(85, 85, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x00700 - 0x04FFF | 18 KiB
free conventional memory

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x05000 - 0x0520D | 526 B
boot parameter stash, BIOS drive list, VBE scratch

div.style: color: rgb(85, 85, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x0520E - 0x05FFF | 3.5 KiB
free

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x06000 - 0x07BFF | 7 KiB max
Multiboot2 boot information from detect.S - about 0x100 B in practice; the disk.S Disk Address Packet lives at 0x7000

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x07C00 - 0x07DFF | 512 B
stage1 boot.bin - MBR boot sector; the disk.S real-mode stack top is also 0x7C00 and grows down, away from it

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x07E00 - 0x1E6AB | 0x168AC
stage2 core.bin - image 0x7E00 - 0xE843 (.entry, .early_data, .text, dead .eh_frame)
plus .bss 0xE860 - 0x1E6AB (loader statics, stage2 statics, uart/vbe statics, vga.c s_Shadow 64000 B, palette, cursors)

div.style: color: rgb(85, 85, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x1E6AC - 0x7EFFF | 386 KiB
free - stage2 .bss ends here; s_Shadow no longer reaches 0x90000, which is what cleared the corefs collision

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x7F000 - 0x7FFFF | 4 KiB
kernel-load trampoline, planned - position-dependent blob, copied here and executed because stage3 cannot survive the copy

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x80000 - 0x8FFFF | 64 KiB
kernel-load bounce buffer, planned - INT 13h can only write below 1 MiB, chunks never cross a 64 KiB boundary

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x90000 - 0x9717F | 0x717F
corefs module - filesystem driver and disk I/O, appended to the boot image by the image builder
exports and text 0x90000 - 0x92ADF, module .bss to 0x9717F (fat; ext2 and iso9660 are smaller). Stays resident, so the kernel loader can call DISK_ReadLBA

div.style: color: rgb(85, 85, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x97180 - 0x9FBFF | 34.6 KiB
free stack headroom - stage2 sets ESP to 0x9FC00 and grows toward lower addresses, so it hits the top of the corefs module first

div.style: color: rgb(85, 85, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x9FC00 - 0x9FFFF | 1 KiB
above the stack top - conventionally the BIOS EBDA

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x0A0000 - 0x0AFFFF | 64 KiB
VGA graphics framebuffer - mode 0x13

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x0B0000 - 0x0B7FFF | 32 KiB
MDA text framebuffer

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x0B8000 - 0x0BFFFF | 32 KiB
colour text framebuffer

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x0C0000 - 0x0FFFFF | 256 KiB
option ROMs and system BIOS

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x100000 - 0x1C6047 | 792 KiB
two users of the same bytes: stage3 window and kernel image
stage3: libTheBootloader.so (0x49BC4) is read here and DL-loaded in place
kernel: linked at 0x100000, two PT_LOAD segments 0x100000 + 0x25D58 and 0x125D60 + 0xA02E8, entry 0x10000C
the trampoline reads the kernel through INT 13h in 64 KiB chunks into 0x80000, copies each chunk up, zeroes .bss, then jumps with Multiboot2 magic 0x36D76289 in EAX and the info pointer 0x6000 in EBX

div.style: color: rgb(85, 85, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.div:
0x1C6048 - 0x1FFFFF | 232 KiB
free RAM above the kernel image
